title: Canyoning is our new favorite hobby!
text: Harry was fantastic. We had a blast. He prepared for a good hike up the hill, and an absolute blast coming down. We didn't realize water shoes weren't included, but lucked out and had our own. This turned out to be one of the most epic days of our trip!
author: Jenna_B

title: Canyoning Adventure with Harry!
text: 5-star reviews all round for Harry!  He made us both feel completely safe throughout the canyoning, and we had such a great time. We finished off the experience with a lovely picnic afterwards, including a well-earned beer. Would definitely recommend
author: 985nicholasm

title: Highlight of my trip
text: Highlight of my trip! The Rio verde is incredibly beautiful and i had so much fun crawling through the river and jumping of rocks. We were in great hands with Harry to guide us and he made us feel perfectly safe the whole way through. The lunch was also really appreciated, as well as the small group setting. Go with Harry, you won’t regret it!
author: 903paulienc

title: Very fun
text: Canyoning was an extraordinary experience, thanks to Harry, who is very professional and approachable.
author: aitzibero781

title: Totally awesome
text: Harry was so great and gave us a great time. Beautiful sights and lots of fun new experiences. Definitely recommend going with Harry. You'll be hungry after but Harry feeds you some great food.
author: 681hailib

title: The Most Fun Day
text: Really incredible experience! Harry was wonderful and did a great job communicating to safely guide us canyoning. He provided transportation, a mid-adventure break snack, and even a very nice picnic at the end. The location was gorgeous. He is extremely experienced and it was great talking with him. Highly recommend
author: Jade_G

title: A great experience, a great guide, well worth the money
text: I took my teenage son and 3 of his mates canyoning (today) with Dim Trap. Harry, the guide, is a really nice bloke. Great with my son and his friends. He is also incredibly knowledgeable and very professional. I wouldn't hesitate to use him/Dim Trap for the other adventure stuff they do having used them for the canyoning. He's been doing this a long time and is a really skilled guide (as well as just a lovely person).
author: Martin D

title: Harry was a great guide!!
text: Harry was awesome! It was just my boyfriend and I on the tour and Harry really took the time to show us the nature, ensure our safety, and made sure we had fun. The picnic after was a great time to chat! I would recommend anyone do this tour!
author: cianna t

title: Canyoning in Rio Verde with Harry
text:
We had an amazing canyoning adventure in Rio Verde, and we couldn't have asked for a better guide than Harry!

From the very beginning, Harry was incredibly friendly, kind, and welcoming. During the more challenging parts of the canyon, he was very patient and always took the time to think along with us, making sure everyone felt safe and confident. His calm and supportive approach really made a difference and helped us enjoy the experience even more.

Harry also surprised us with a delicious picnic lunch, which was a perfect break during the adventure. It was such a thoughtful touch!

It was

title: Great experience
text: Harry picked us up in town and drove us to the site which was very helpful. My husband and I had a wonderful time with the group. Harry was patient and gave suggestions for those that did not want to do the higher jumps. We would go with him again! Lunch was also perfect afterwards. Book it!
